snippet.title: The Answer Is Behind You (Horror Visual Novel) | GAMEPLAY
snippet.description:
About the game:
A short horror visual novel, in which your duty is to translate a language never seen before.


Synopsis:
You, a professional translator, are contacted by a researcher asking for assistance with a text written in a language never seen before. The offer is too tempting to refuse... but what secrets does this long-forgotten language hold?


Download the game:
https://crofteriagames.itch.io/the-answer-is-behind-you
